product_one_liner.value: Authentic8’s Silo provides secure, anonymous, cloud-based workspaces for intelligence, security, financial-crime and law-enforcement analysts to investigate online activity and capture and analyze evidence.
product_one_liner.notes: The company’s job description explains Silo’s secure, anonymous cloud workspaces and evidence capture and analysis, and names its specialist users. Source: https://jobs.lever.co/authentic8/adfd9fa8-f386-41a9-bdd3-b62ea4e5012d

pricing_page.notes: Authentic8 has a public Plans and Pricing page describing per-user, annual pricing. Source: https://authentic8.com/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The case studies explicitly describe Secure Network Technologies analysts using Silo and NCDOC personnel deploying and accessing it. Both are actual named users, not merely partners or investors. Sources: https://www.authentic8.com/why-authentic8/success-stories/silo-helps-white-hat-hackers-secure-clients-networks ; https://authentic8.com/success-story/enabling-remote-work-discriminating-professionals | named_customers.0: The case study explicitly describes Secure Network Technologies analysts using Silo for Research. Source: https://www.authentic8.com/why-authentic8/success-stories/silo-helps-white-hat-hackers-secure-clients-networks | named_customers.1: The case study names NCDOC and describes its commanding officer encouraging the command to use Silo following deployment. Source: https://authentic8.com/success-story/enabling-remote-work-discriminating-professionals

employee_band.notes: PitchBook reports 127 employees, which falls within the 101–200 band. This is a third-party headcount estimate. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/52264-81

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Authentic8’s company profile explicitly identifies Redwood City, California, as its headquarters. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/571385 | hq_country: The LEI record identifies the headquarters country as the United States. Source: https://www.gleif.org/lei/2549009TD9M2J0O7Q179

founded_year.notes: Authentic8’s About Us page explicitly states that it was established in 2010. This uses the company’s stated establishment year, although a founder’s profile describes earlier activity in 2009. Source: https://authentic8.com/about-us

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index presents investigative guidance and managed-attribution content, rather than at least two engineer-authored accounts of building Authentic8’s product. It therefore meets the requested negative criterion. Source: https://authentic8.com/blog

public_docs.notes: The public knowledge base contains numerous product articles, including system requirements, SAML SSO configuration and a file-management API reference. Source: https://support.authentic8.com/support/solutions

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable current job board lists Governance Administration Specialist and Sales Development Representative openings, with no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title. Source: https://jobs.lever.co/authentic8

model_provider.notes: No specific underlying AI model or inference provider was identified in the product/security FAQ, support article, launch blog or subprocessor list. They refer generically to external AI providers. Brave is identified as a search API service, not an inference provider, so it is not substituted for the unknown model provider. Sources: https://authentic8.com/silo-nexus-ai ; https://support.authentic8.com/support/solutions/articles/16000236939-silo-nexus-ai ; https://authentic8.com/blog/whats-new-with-silo-nexus-ai-v2 ; https://authentic8.com/third-party-processors

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Vistara explicitly calls the $12 million transaction a debt facility. That primary investor description is preferred over secondary databases that label the same transaction later-stage venture capital. Source: https://vistaragrowth.com/portfolio-news/vistara-growth-invests-12m-in-authentic8 | funding_date: The investor announcement is dated October 8, 2025; the latest PitchBook transaction is dated October 9, 2025. Both support the requested month, 2025-10. Sources: https://vistaragrowth.com/portfolio-news/vistara-growth-invests-12m-in-authentic8 ; https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/52264-81 | funding_amount_usd: Vistara’s announcement states a US$12 million investment. PitchBook’s latest listed transaction independently gives $12 million in October 2025. Sources: https://vistaragrowth.com/portfolio-news/vistara-growth-invests-12m-in-authentic8 ; https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/52264-81

raised_18mo.notes: The investor announced a $12 million debt facility in October 2025, inside the 18-month window beginning in May 2025. Source: https://vistaragrowth.com/portfolio-news/vistara-growth-invests-12m-in-authentic8

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Sales Development Representative, Commercial posting is also listed on the current company job board. Sources: https://jobs.lever.co/authentic8/0cdeb8d9-72b8-4eba-ba13-1432e6eb24cc ; https://jobs.lever.co/authentic8

launched_6mo.notes: The August 19, 2026 Nexus AI v2 announcement introduces investigation roles, additional file formats, browser and Silo Drive integrations, custom prompts and conversation search. These constitute a major feature release within the six-month window. Source: https://authentic8.com/blog/whats-new-with-silo-nexus-ai-v2

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Miguel Ramos’s profile dates the start of his Chief Product Officer role to January 2026, following Head of Product, and the company leadership page confirms his CPO title. This is an internal appointment into a C-level role within the window, not a new-company hire. Sources: https://linkedin.com/in/miguelramosv ; https://authentic8.com/company/leadership-team
